options: A backup copy of the metadata repository
The raw data before any metadata is attached
A list of all tables in a database
questions.explanation: Giving more information about Metadata is called Meta Metadata.

questions.stem: What is the simple definition of Metadata that Meta Metadata builds on?
questions.explanation: Metadata is Data About Data, and Meta Metadata goes one level further.

questions.stem: A column named Date of Birth (DOB) is given as an example of which kind of metadata?
questions.explanation: A Date of Birth column is technical metadata; tagging whose DOB it is makes it Meta Metadata.

questions.stem: How does the Date of Birth example become Meta Metadata?
options: By storing the date in a different format
By moving the column to a different table
By tagging whether the DOB is for parents, children, employees or an insurance policy maker
By renaming the column to Birthday
questions.explanation: Tagging that the DOB belongs to parents, children, employees or an insurance policy maker makes the DOB attribute more relevant, which is Meta Metadata.

questions.stem: In the Weight column example, what cannot be told from the numeric value alone?
options: Whether the value is a number
Whether the weight is for a person or an object, and which object
Whether the table has a primary key
Whether the value is stored as text
questions.explanation: Looking at the value alone you cannot tell whether the weight belongs to a person or an object, or which object such as furniture.

questions.stem: How is Meta Metadata described in terms of its arrival in the Data World?
options: As something that has just surfaced and is a game changer
As a replacement for technical metadata
As a term used only in academia
questions.explanation: Meta Metadata is described as something that has just surfaced in the Data World and is again a game changer.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the groups suggested for tagging a Date of Birth column?
questions.explanation: The examples given are parents, children, employees and insurance policy maker; suppliers are not mentioned.

questions.stem: What effect does Meta Metadata have on an attribute such as DOB?
options: It makes the attribute more relevant
It removes the attribute from the table
It converts the attribute into a key column
It hides the attribute from users
questions.explanation: Tagging the DOB attribute with whose date it is makes the attribute more relevant.

questions.stem: Which object type is offered as a possible subject of a Weight value when illustrating Meta Metadata?
questions.explanation: The Weight example asks whether the value is for a person or an object, and further which object, for example furniture.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes the relationship between Metadata and Meta Metadata?
options: Meta Metadata is the raw data that Metadata describes
Metadata describes data, and Meta Metadata gives more information about that Metadata
Metadata and Meta Metadata are the same thing
Meta Metadata is only used for operational logs
questions.explanation: Metadata is data about data, and Meta Metadata is the next level: giving more information about the Metadata itself.
